cite.text: MESO NUMISMATICS, INC. · S-1 filed Jan 2, 2024 · Nine months ended Sep 30, 2023

analysis: Revenue was $1.8M in 9M 2023, up 86% year over year.

Gross margin was 69.2%, up 15.4 points from 9M 2022. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $9.6M, an operating margin of -532.6%. Operating expenses grew 115% against revenue growth of 86%. The fastest-growing cost line was Other operating costs (+121%). The period ended with a net loss of $9.6M.

Operating cash flow was −$390K. Non-cash charges added back $213K of depreciation and amortization. Working capital and other items added $9.0M. Capital expenditures of $102K exceeded it, leaving free cash flow of −$491K.
